subject_rule: Open to any subject: Oxford's Faculty of Law says the scholarship has no restrictions on nationality, ordinary residence or field of study, and the Department of Social Policy and Intervention says awards are made across all subject areas.
notes: No list of courses is published because none is needed: the scheme covers all Oxford Master's and DPhil courses, so no majors are recorded.
Wording on the field of study was read on three Oxford department pages; the central Oxford Clarendon pages could not be read (see fetch_problems).
not_stated: No official list of eligible courses; the sources say all subject areas are eligible.
fetch_problems: The central University of Oxford Clarendon pages (the Clarendon Fund page and its applicants page) return HTTP 403 Forbidden to automated reading; not bypassed. The subject wording above comes from Oxford department pages instead.
